visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation begins on a white background with a cartoon calico cat character energetically jumping and dancing. Text in green and yellow appears above the cat, introducing a sticker pack for the whole year. The cat has a white body with orange and black spots and simple black eyes. (2) A new scene shows the calico cat character holding a bouquet of pink flowers with its paws. The cat has a happy expression with closed eyes. Above the cat, pink text appears while tiny pink flowers float in the background environment. (3) The cat is seen sitting next to a large white cake topped with a single red candle and a strawberry. The cat is holding a piece of red fruit in its mouth, eyes closed in delight against the plain white backdrop. (4) The calico cat jumps across the screen from left to right against a backdrop of small pink flowers. The cat's mouth is open in a joyful expression. The text above indicates excitement for a break or holiday. (5) A funny animation shows the calico cat's head emerging from a zongzi (sticky rice dumpling) wrap made of leaves. The cat has its mouth wide open as if shouting or yawning. The lighting is flat and consistent. (6) A different cat character, a ginger tabby, is shown against a dark blue night background with stylized clouds. The cat is holding a large, glowing yellow full moon. The text above features a humorous comparison about roundness. (7) The ginger tabby cat appears again, this time wearing a yellow hard hat and holding a grey wrench in its right paw and a wooden sign in its left. The cat has a determined facial expression. (8) A purple-tinted cat character wearing a traditional Chinese official hat is shown with two small yellow ghost figures floating nearby. The cat looks surprised or scared. (9) The calico cat is shown wearing a large black fake mustache and the same traditional official hat. It looks directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. (10) A black cat with white angel wings is depicted as Cupid, lying on its belly and aiming a red heart-tipped arrow with a wooden bow. (11) The calico cat is happily eating from a blue bowl filled with tangyuan. Steam rises from the bowl, and the cat has a blissful expression with its mouth open. (12) A grey and white cat is shown sleeping soundly inside a green circular area that looks like a cushion. The cat is curled up with its eyes tightly shut. (13) The ginger tabby cat is shown sitting on a grey cushion, with lines around its body indicating it is shaking violently. The cat has wide, shocked eyes. (14) A mock news broadcast screen appears with a logo and a map of Taiwan. The calico cat's head is placed inside a spinning typhoon symbol over the map. (15) The final screen shows the black cat Cupid character again at the bottom, with large green and grey text detailing the official sticker information.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a commercial showcase for a set of LINE stickers featuring the popular IP characters of Fumean Cat. It uses a rapid compilation of various animated stickers tailored for different holidays and life events throughout the year to demonstrate the pack's utility and cute appeal, ending with a call to purchase.
